30 October 2026: POI_IDENTIFIERS source-note editorial revision

Later source-reference revision (same date): 1,220 SOURCE_REF values now use
register: in place of synthetic:. The two exact source groups retain their
remaining suffixes, dates and versions. The other 63 references are unchanged.
No actual agent, application, officer or independent reviewer is attributed.
backend/poi-identifier-sources.js canonicalizes the two old spellings for
imports while keeping their original source identity for deterministic ID
calculation. All 1,283 IDENTIFIER_ID values stay unchanged. Historical seeds
remain historical; both source spellings prepare the same key and current
SOURCE_REF. Unrelated source names are never canonicalized.

Run node scripts/refresh_poi_identifier_source_refs.cjs --check to verify source
references and IDs. The latest note verifier accepts both source spellings.
Backup, mapping CSV and transaction receipts:
/home/opc/scratch/poi-identifier-source-refs-20261030/

scripts/refresh_poi_identifier_notes.cjs rewrites SOURCE_NOTE for the existing
1,283 assertions across 12 profiles. Notes use natural register language and
retain the distinction between declared, proposed and expired assertions.
Reserved .test mailboxes, reserved-range phone numbers and unverified account
ownership remain clearly described. No evidence extraction or external account
verification is claimed, and no author or reviewer is invented.

Only SOURCE_NOTE changes. The importer compares complete rows to protect IDs,
person/profile keys, values, normalization, namespace, type, source references,
recorder/reviewer attribution, review status, validity dates and creation dates.
Live and saved person registers and active-profile state are also compared.
It verifies Tone resolves, proposed pippy and expired Slate Pipit do not match,
and the declared username kappa66 still resolves to George Kaplan.

Run node scripts/refresh_poi_identifier_notes.cjs --check for current notes.
--dry-run validates against the captured baseline and rolls back; --apply
requires that baseline and refuses to overwrite its before-change backup.
Backup, prepared notes, review CSV and receipts:
/home/opc/scratch/poi-identifiers-quality-20261030/

Historical identifier/profile loaders that assert the former SOURCE_NOTE text
will correctly report an attribution-metadata conflict after this authorised
editorial revision. Do not replay historical seeds to overwrite current notes.
The original source and recorder fields retain the creation provenance.
